title: MFP PT 3.0
desc: MFP PT program for RCP/BCP. Increase aerobic endurance for 3 mile time and overall strength/hypertrophy

ex.note:
25 min 3 mile goal: 2:02 per 400m 
29 min 3 mile goal: 2:24 per 400m
60s rest

ss.note: Partition reps in sets of 5-10-15 of pullups/pushups/squats If unable to do 10 or more pullups switch to inverted rows or use band
if unable to maintain 10 reps switch to knees
1 min rest inbetween circuit

ex.note: Conduct swim workout ranging from 30-60 min. Swim @ experience level and increase intensity/volume each week

ss.note: Superset with 1-2 min rest
If unable to do more than 10 pullups, use assistance via machine or band

ex.note: 2-3 min for 500m maintain or increase speed of each set

ss.note: switch sides @ 30s
